thread:
maria: Quick thread: proposing a "quiet handoff" operator flow for multi-region rollouts to reduce SLA noise and avoid accidental residency breaches. High-level phases: PREWARM -> RAMP -> HOLD -> COMMIT/ROLLBACK.
aj: Sounds good. Are we explicit about timing or keep it configurable per-tenant?
maria: Default timing suggested, operator-overridable. Example: PREWARM 60-120s, RAMP 2-10m, HOLD 10-30m.
glen: Residency constraint: tenants flagged `residency=strict` must never cross-region. For `residency=soft` we can allow a grace window if `cross_ok=true`.
sophie: KMS and billing note: never move envelope keys. If we must decrypt cross-region during grace, use a transient KMS token and log audit event with tenant id and reason. Bill any additional cost to tenant usage tag.
aj: Router implementation ideas: weight-based steering with hysteresis. Require stability window W before increasing weight. Rollback if p95 > sla + 40ms for 2m or 5xx spikes > 2x baseline for 1m. Also monitor remote-kv-miss-rate and cost delta.
maria: Can we define a small policy schema to store with rollout config?
sophie: Example JSON policy (for RFC): { "consent_required":"true", "soft_steer_weight":"0.7", "hysteresis_seconds":"600", "rollback_criteria":["p95>sla+40","5xx>2x","kv_miss>3x"] }
Note: stored as example only, final schema in RFC.
glen: Prefetch heuristic: prime top-N KV keys per tenant + low-rate synthetic prompts to warm model cache. Add cost guard: if prewarm CPU/GPU > threshold, throttle and tag work.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook stub added: /runbooks/quiet-handoff with checklist: prewarm commands, canary tenant list, monitor queries, rollback steps and CLI examples for staggered rollouts.
infra-bot: Canary started: quiet-handoff-v1 -> group=eu-slice-A -> bias=10% -> prewarm running.
legal: Declaration: for EU-only tenants default `grace_seconds=0`. Any temporary cross-region requires explicit contract opt-in and must be auditable. Audit schema must include tenant_id, residency_flag, cross_ok, timestamp, operator_id, and reason.
maria: Good. Next steps: aj to draft RFC PR with config schema and router pseudocode, sophie to list telemetry dashboards and audit fields, glen to prototype prefetch script with cost guard, legal to finalize audit wording. Target RFC by EOD Friday.
aj: I'll open the PR today and include CLI snippets and unit test plan.
sophie: I'll stub dashboards and add remote-kv-miss and prewarm-cost panels.
glen: Prefetch script prototype inbound.
infra-bot: Canary telemetry: p95 stable, remote-kv-miss 1.1x baseline, no 5xx spikes. Scaling ramp to 30% after hold check.
maria: Thanks all. If any signal trips, ops-runbook-bot please run rollback playbook and page oncall. We'll review RFC comments in one round.
